question: Should omitted Active Memory `config.agents` replace the shipped explicit opt-in contract with every configured agent?
rationale: The linked bug proves inconsistent target handling, but broad inherited activation is a separate compatibility and session-behavior choice that source inspection cannot decide safely.

options.title: Preserve explicit targeting
options.body: Narrow the repair to consistent setup, command, and recall gates without activating omitted configurations across every agent.

options.title: Approve inherited targeting
options.body: Adopt the new omitted-field default and explicitly accept its upgrade-visible activation and session effects.

options.title: Keep the current contract
options.body: Decline this direction and retain explicit agent lists plus the documented workaround.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit targeting
recommendation.body: Narrow the repair to consistent setup, command, and recall gates without activating omitted configurations across every agent.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced Active Memory and the targeting surface whose permanent contract is being changed.
